transforms.code: return 'dark' if 'dark' in (value or '') else 'light'
return list((dict(value) if value else {}).get('categories') or [])

# A colour per asset, in a fixed order; the rest of the assets grey
	COLORS = ['#489fe2', '#0a369d', '#f96900', '#f7b801', '#a2aa8a', '#2b6088', '#fa8733', '#69714c', '#06205e', '#fad467', '#8e5cc2', '#3fa796']
	stacks = list((dict(value) if value else {}).get('stacks') or [])
	return ['#9E9E9E' if st['other'] else COLORS[i % len(COLORS)] for i, st in enumerate(stacks)]

# One series per asset (or the rest of them): its minutes in each category
	u = dict(value) if value else {}
	cats = list(u.get('categories') or [])
	return [{'name': st['name'], 'data': [int(round(dict(st['mins']).get(c, 0))) for c in cats]} for st in (u.get('stacks') or [])]
return 'dark' if 'dark' in (value or '') else 'light'
return [dict(r)['category'] for r in (value or []) if dict(r)['category'] != 'No data']

COLORS = {'Production (scheduled)': '#5B8C2A', 'Production (unscheduled)': '#A8C97F',
			  'Production delay': '#E0A100', 'Changeover & setup': '#2F6FB5', 'Maintenance': '#B3261E',
			  'Cleaning': '#8E5CC2', 'Idle': '#8A8A8A', 'Other': '#E07B22', 'No data': '#D0D0D0'}
	return [COLORS.get(dict(r)['category'], '#8A8A8A') for r in (value or []) if dict(r)['category'] != 'No data']

# Time with a mode recorded: 'No data' isn't plotted
	return [int(round(dict(r)['mins'])) for r in (value or []) if dict(r)['category'] != 'No data']

# How often production started late in a scheduled Production block, or not at all
	s = dict(value) if value else {}
	if not s.get('hasSchedule'):
		return 'No Production blocks in the operations schedule started in this range.'
	blocks = s['blocks']
	pct = lambda n: 100.0 * n / blocks if blocks else 0
	return ('{:,} scheduled blocks\n'.format(blocks) +
			'On time: {:,} ({:.0f}%)\n'.format(s['onTime'], pct(s['onTime'])) +
			'Started late: {:,} ({:.0f}%)\n'.format(s['late'], pct(s['late'])) +
			'Not started: {:,} ({:.0f}%)\n'.format(s['missed'], pct(s['missed'])) +
			'Delay: {:,.0f} min in all, {:,.0f} min on average\n'.format(s['delayMins'], s['avgDelayMins']) +
			'Late means production began more than {} min after the block.'.format(s['lateAfterMins']))

# The loss families and their buckets, in the order they come off planned run time
	FAMILIES = [
		('AVAILABILITY', 'Availability', 'var(--kcRed-60)', [('UNPLANNED', 'Unplanned downtime')]),
		('PERFORMANCE', 'Performance', 'var(--kcOrange-60)', [('MINOR_STOP', 'Minor stops'), ('SPEED_LOSS', 'Speed loss')]),
		('QUALITY', 'Quality', 'var(--kcPurple-60)', [('QUALITY_LOSS', 'Quality loss')]),
	]
	# The three loss cards, the biggest one marked
	summary = dict(value['summary']) if value['summary'] else {}
	lost = dict(summary.get('lost') or {})
	buckets = dict((r['bucket'], r['mins']) for r in (summary.get('buckets') or []))
	planned = summary.get('plannedRunMins') or 0
	top = max(lost.values()) if lost else 0
	cards = []
	for key, name, color, members in FAMILIES:
		mins = lost.get(key, 0.0)
		biggest = max(members, key=lambda b: buckets.get(b[0], 0.0))
		cards.append({'family': key, 'label': name + ' loss', 'color': color, 'mins': mins, 'pct': 100.0 * mins / planned if planned else 0.0,
					  'biggest': biggest[1] if buckets.get(biggest[0], 0.0) > 0 and len(members) > 1 else '',
					  'isTop': bool(top) and mins == top, 'selected': value['drill']['family'] == key})
	return cards
return ({'AVAILABILITY': 'Availability', 'PERFORMANCE': 'Performance', 'QUALITY': 'Quality'}.get(value, 'All') + ' losses') + ' (click one to see where it came from)'
